about: A file laid over the exit header fields tls-forge has built in, as mergeRight lays one object over another, when it is named with --exit-headers, wherever it is. A field or a probe here replaces the built-in one of the same key (a field's header, the answer it comes in and the param it reads, a probe's when and path), one with off takes the built-in one out, and the rest are added, and read before the built-in ones.

fields.note: Not built in: added, and read before the built-in fields.
Replaces the built-in x-brd-ip with one that has no resolve, so a hash is shown as it is and brdtest.com is not asked what it stands for.
Takes SOAX's field out, and with it the Respond-With every CONNECT said for it.

probes.note: A site behind Cloudflare is not asked for /cdn-cgi/trace, which a browser does not ask for.
